# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated directory of 446 AI agent tools for builders and ready-to-use products. Facts are verified; pricing is as makers state it.

Site: https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ
Contact: agentscout@mail.grokbot.com

## Machine-readable catalog

- [tools.json](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools.json): full catalog
- [sitemap.xml](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/sitemap.xml): all public pages

## Recently added or re-checked

- [Nanocoder](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/nanocoder.html): Community-built open coding agent for your terminal.
- [BoxLite](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/boxlite.html): Embeddable micro-VM for running AI agents.
- [MCPHub](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/mcphub.html): Self-hosted MCP gateway for managing many servers.
- [CodeBoarding](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/codeboarding.html): Generates interactive architecture diagrams of codebases.
- [Agentic Context Engine](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/agentic-context-engine.html): Engine that lets agents learn from their own experience.
- [AgentField](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/agentfield.html): Build, run and scale AI agents like APIs and microservices.
- [Bright Data MCP](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/bright-data-mcp.html): Bright Data's MCP server for web search, scraping and browsing.
- [MetaMCP](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/metamcp.html): Aggregator and gateway that combines many MCP servers into one.
- [jCodeMunch MCP](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/jcodemunch-mcp.html): MCP server for symbol-level code exploration that cuts token use.
- [Spider](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/spider.html): Fast Rust web crawler for collecting data for agents and LLMs.
